r.deploymentRegimeDesign:
fr13_measure now measures the 4 deployment numbers ON the real SWE-Verified + codex trajectory (chat-templated /v1/responses, multi-turn, real tool calls), made canonical via two new subcommands in scripts/fr13_measure.py.

(1) cmd_deploy_speed (subcommand `deploy-speed`, schema fr13.measure.deploy_speed.v1, kind=speed, instrument=OFF, regime=deployment): the KEY plumbing realization is that scripts/run_swe_bench_q36_a.py (the codex agent loop) ALREADY brackets /metrics per task into vllm_metrics_pre.txt / vllm_metrics_post.txt (lines 609/627/669), and those snapshots contain exactly the four counters fr13_measure already uses (request_decode_time_seconds_sum, spec_decode_num_drafts_total, spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total, spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total). So deploy-speed aggregates the raw-counter delta over all per-task brackets under a run_swe_bench out-root -> s/fwd = d(decode_seconds)/d(drafts), accept/event = d(accepted)/d(drafts) on the deployment trajectory, committed = accept+1, derived TPS = committed/s_fwd. SAME truthful basis as the deprecated cmd_speed, only the trajectory differs (real codex loop, NO degenerate fork). Banned bases still blocked (assert_speed_basis), class-9 engagement gate (tok/draft over the whole workload == expected: 5 native, len(TREE)=9 cat9). Verified smoke on the proven big-denom run: cat9 s/fwd 0.248 accept 3.685 TPS 18.88; native_e5 s/fwd 0.233 accept 3.267 TPS 18.28 — both healthy (vs the off-distribution raw-prompt 1.589 degenerate fork).

(2) cmd_deploy_lossless (subcommand `deploy-lossless`, schema fr13.measure.deploy_lossless.v1, kind=lossless, instrument=ON, regime=deployment): consumes the big-denom rescore consolidation (fr13.bigdenom_rescore_consolidate.v1) and emits the within-floor lossless verdict — cat9 vs native-E5, each vs its OWN no-spec RECURRENT decode oracle clear-margin flip rate + Wilson CI. within_floor iff cat9 not Wilson-separated ABOVE native (native-E5 = the BAR). Fail-loud on non-engaged oracle (#9) and non-round-trip denominator (#12). Verified smoke: cat9 1181/8717=13.548% [12.846,14.283] vs native 1224/8752=13.985% [13.275,14.728] -> LOSSLESS_within_floor (CIs overlap), within_proc_det both.

Module docstring + SUBCOMMANDS section re-aimed: deployment regime declared canonical (the 4 numbers come from deploy-speed/deploy-lossless ONLY), the degenerate <think></think> loop documented as the cautionary artifact.
r.machineryIntegrated:
fr13_measure ORCHESTRATES the proven big-denom machinery, it does NOT re-invent it. New orchestrator entry points in scripts/fr13_measure_orchestrate.sh chain the existing scripts:
- deploy-serve ARM_DIR {cat9|native} [SUBSET] -> runs scripts/fr13_bigdenom_swe_serve.sh, which boots the arm (cat9 via fr13_launch_locked.sh / native via fr10_launch_speed_server.sh num_spec=5) + runs scripts/run_swe_bench_q36_a.py (the codex agent loop, the gold-gate-proven astropy-12907 path) with the proxy pair-dump ON (LUMO_PROXY_PAIR_DUMP_DIR via inference_proxy.py) + raw-/metrics spec-engagement asserts + per-task /metrics brackets. GPU stage; serve.sh owns its own pre-boot hygiene + teardown + recover.
- deploy-speed LABEL ARM_DIR EXPECT_RATIO [B] -> calls fr13_measure deploy-speed on that arm's swe_out (CPU reduce of the brackets serve.sh already produced).
- deploy-rescore -> runs scripts/fr13_bigdenom_phase3_rescore.sh (fr13_swe_stream_to_oracle_src.py byte-exact detok pair-dump -> oracle --src; fr13_recurrent_decode_oracle.py rescore = the no-spec recurrent oracle flip; fr13_bigdenom_rescore_consolidate.py Wilson CI) then fr13_measure deploy-lossless on the consolidated.json. GPU stage.
- deploy-full [SUBSET] [B] -> serialized end-to-end chain: serve native -> deploy-speed native -> serve cat9 -> deploy-speed cat9 -> deploy-rescore (each stage waits + recovers, GPU-serialized, MAX 2 workflows respected).
Nothing in the big-denom harness is reimplemented; fr13_measure adds only the two CPU reducers (metrics-bracket -> speed, consolidation -> lossless verdict) and the shell glue.
